第29章 免费的才是最贵的-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

上一章

存书签

下一章

宽敞的饭店包厢装饰华丽，圆形桌子上摆满了饭菜却没人动筷子。

陈贺大气不敢喘的看着导演韦正和编剧汪远。

此时此刻，他比任何人都紧张。

曾小贤这个角色能否拿下就看今天。

今天张罗这场饭局本就是冒险一试。

他听过《体面》，也很喜欢这首歌。

宿舍几个人中，他最佩服魏沐，认为其最有才华。

可是今天对方的表现却让他大跌眼镜。

哥们，玩呢？

随便听一下故事梗概，然后花一个小时把歌词整出来？

这特么是人干出来的事？

陈贺严重怀疑是今天早晨豆腐脑的问题。

就不应该买咸豆腐脑！！

再看当事人魏沐，低着头玩俄罗斯方块，好像一切跟自己没关系。

陈贺眼中失去了色彩。

“怎么样？”

韦正关切的看向好搭档。

他学音乐出身，对乐理方面比较了解。

但歌词方面，显然是编剧出身的汪远更加擅长。

汪远是演艺世家，从小就对文学创作和戏剧表演表现出超长的兴趣。

他对音乐不是很感冒，但歌词也是文学创作的一种。

汪远能读懂魏沐写下的歌词。

歌名《爱的回归线》

将爱情比作地球公转的回归线，既象征周期性的分离和重逢，也暗示情感的永恒轨迹。

这不正是主角们的爱情吗？

《爱情公寓》虽然只打算拍第一季，但是汪远早有打算。

只要第一部收视率过关，马上启动第二部。

主角团一共七人，其中三对暧昧组合。

曾小贤胡一菲

陈美嘉吕子乔

陆展博林宛瑜

第一季里面，这三对暧昧组合都不会在一起，否则后面拍什么？

这种情景喜剧，一定要有拉扯！

比如《老友记》里面的罗斯和瑞秋，两位主角从第一季开始拉扯，一直拉扯到最后一季。

分分合合永不停。

即便这样，观众依然乐此不疲的追剧。

除此之外，还有《老爸老妈的浪漫史》

这部剧的两男一女还是在拉扯。

人家老外都已经把答案写好了，照抄就行！！

作为资深美剧爱好者，汪远觉得《爱的回归线》太适合他们这部剧。

The spacious hotel room was ornately decorated, and the round table was filled with food but no one used chopsticks.

Chen He looked at director Wei Zheng and screenwriter Wang Yuan with an air of breathlessness.

At this moment, he was more nervous than anyone else.

Whether we can win the role of Zeng Xiaoxian depends on today.

Organizing this dinner party today was just a risk.

He had heard "Decent" and liked the song.

Among the people in the dormitory, he admired Wei Mu the most and thought he was the most talented.

But the opponent's performance today surprised him.

Dude, are you playing?

Just listen to the synopsis of the story and then spend an hour coming up with the lyrics?

Is this something done by humans?

Chen He seriously suspected that it was the tofu nao problem this morning.

You shouldn’t buy salted tofu curd!!

Look at Wei Mu, the person involved, playing Tetris with his head down, as if everything has nothing to do with him.

Chen He's eyes lost color.

"How's it going?"

Wei Zheng looked at his good partner with concern.

He studied music and has a good understanding of music theory.

But in terms of lyrics, Wang Yuan, who is obviously a screenwriter, is better at it.

Wang Yuan comes from a family of performers and has shown a long-term interest in literary creation and drama performances since he was a child.

He is not very interested in music, but lyrics are also a kind of literary creation.

Wang Yuan can understand the lyrics written by Wei Mu.

Song title "The Line of Return of Love"

Comparing love to the Tropic of Tropic in the earth's revolution not only symbolizes the periodic separation and reunion, but also implies the eternal trajectory of emotion.

Isn’t this the love of the protagonists?

Although "Love Apartment" only plans to shoot the first season, Wang Yuan has already made plans.

As long as the ratings of the first part pass, the second part will be launched immediately.

There are seven protagonists in the group, including three ambiguous pairs.

Zeng Xiaoxian Hu Yifei

Meijia Chen and Lu Ziqiao

Lu Zhan Bolin Wanyu

In the first season, these three ambiguous pairs will not be together, otherwise what will be filmed later?

This kind of sitcom must have some pull!

For example, Ross and Rachel in "Friends", the two protagonists started fighting each other from the first season until the last season.

The division and division never stop.

Even so, the audience is still chasing the show endlessly.

In addition, there is "How I Met Your Mother"

The two men and one woman in this drama are still fighting each other.

The foreigners have already written down the answers, so just copy them!!

As a veteran American drama lover, Wang Yuan feels that "Line of Return" is a perfect fit for their drama.
